## tinymist-flow

**Read and review live Typst documents on your Mac, phone, or tablet.**

tinymist-flow is a macOS menu bar app that manages Typst projects and their live previews. Edit your source in your usual editor, then read the result in a browser, mark passages, and save selected text for a follow-up with Codex.

[User guide](docs/tinymist/flow-app.md) · [Try the reading demo](docs/tinymist/examples/reading-demo.typ) · [Issues](https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow/issues) · [Development guide](docs/dev-guide.md)

## What you can do

| Feature | How you use it |
| --- | --- |
| Live project previews | Add a `.typ` entry file, then start, stop, or restart its preview from the menu bar. Saved source edits update connected viewers. |
| Mobile reading and selection | Open the project’s configured HTTPS address on your phone or tablet. Select and copy text with the device’s native selection handles. |
| Source highlights | Select a passage and choose **Highlight** (하이라이트). Supported selections are saved in the Typst source and appear in exports. |
| Browser review marks | Choose **Red strike** (빨간 취소선) for a temporary review mark. Undo or clear marks in this browser without changing source. |
| Saved Codex context | Choose **Save for Codex** (Codex 저장) to save selected text and location for a later question. A configured selection reader lets Codex use that context. |
| Device document themes | Choose System, Light, or Dark independently in each viewer. Documents that support the theme input change their native palette. |
| Reference return | Follow an equation, figure, or heading reference, then choose **Back to reference** to resume reading. |
| Change navigation | Reopen a preview at its latest rendered visual edit, or use **Jump to change** while reading elsewhere. |

![Flow reading demo in a phone-sized preview with selected text and the Highlight, Save for Codex, and Red strike toolbar](docs/tinymist/images/mobile-selection.png)

The [reading demo](docs/tinymist/examples/reading-demo.typ) in the actual preview frontend at a phone-sized touch viewport. The bottom toolbar appears when text is selected. See the [user guide](docs/tinymist/flow-app.md) for each action’s steps and conditions.

## Open your first preview

If Flow is installed, follow these steps. For a new Mac, use the [first-install instructions](#first-install) below first.

1. Open `~/Applications/tinymist-flow.app`.
2. Click **Add Project** (프로젝트 추가…) and select your document’s `.typ` entry file. To try the features, select `docs/tinymist/examples/reading-demo.typ` from this checkout.
3. If the document belongs to a larger workspace, set **Project folder** (프로젝트 폴더) to its root. Add any required font or package folders, then click **Save settings** (설정 저장).
4. Click **Start** (시작), then **Open Preview** (프리뷰 열기). Wait for the document to render.
5. Save a source edit in your editor to see the preview update. Select a sentence to reveal the reading actions.

Closing the app leaves started previews running. Use **Stop** (중지) to stop a project and disable its automatic service startup. The app’s **Usage, update and recovery guide** (사용·업데이트·복구 안내) menu opens the bundled PDF.

### Read on your phone or tablet

Set up the project’s Tailscale HTTPS route in Tail Hosting, enter that address in **HTTPS address** (HTTPS 주소), and save the project settings. Use **Copy address** (주소 복사) and open the HTTPS URL on a device with access to the same tailnet. Flow’s local `127.0.0.1` address works only on the Mac running the preview; entering an HTTPS address in Flow does not create a route. Follow the [mobile access guide](docs/tinymist/flow-app.md#read-on-a-phone-or-tablet) for the setup and checks.

## First install

Use macOS 13 or newer. App packaging requires the Swift compiler and Python 3. Cloning and building the preview frontend also requires Git, Node.js and Yarn; building the engine requires the workspace Rust toolchain.

On a fresh machine with no existing Flow engine, build the maintained frontend and engine:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow.git
cd tinymist-flow
yarn install --immutable
node scripts/build.mjs build:preview
python3 scripts/flow-app.py build --build-engine --jobs 2
python3 scripts/flow-app.py install dist/tinymist-flow.app
```

The Rust toolchain is specified in `rust-toolchain.toml`. Use a native ARM Python environment on Apple Silicon. After installation, follow **Open your first preview** above.

If you already have a compatible `flow-engine` from a Flow bundle, you can package it instead:

```sh
python3 scripts/flow-app.py build --engine /absolute/path/to/flow-engine
python3 scripts/flow-app.py install dist/tinymist-flow.app
```

This path needs the app packaging tools but does not rebuild Rust or the preview frontend. A compatible Flow engine supplies device themes, mobile selection, saved Codex context and change navigation. An arbitrary upstream tinymist executable is not assumed to supply these features.

## Update an existing installation

When `~/Applications/tinymist-flow.app` already exists, the build reuses its engine by default:

```sh
python3 scripts/flow-app.py build
python3 scripts/flow-app.py install dist/tinymist-flow.app
```

Use `--build-engine --jobs 2` after rebuilding the preview frontend when you also need engine or preview changes. App-only rebuilds with the installed engine keep its existing preview features. The installer preserves the previous bundle for recovery. See the [update and recovery guide](docs/tinymist/flow-app.md#update-and-recover) for verification, rollback, signing and macOS consent.

## Development

This repository maintains the native app, tinymist engine, preview frontend, packaging, branding, tests, and documentation. Packaging can reuse a compatible external engine or build the maintained sources.

```sh
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/flow-app -v
python3 scripts/flow-app.py verify dist/tinymist-flow.app
```

For a release, pass `--version` with the intended release number and build from a clean commit. The manifest records the Flow source revision, engine provenance, build settings and signing mode. See the [development guide](docs/dev-guide.md) for engine builds, validation and documentation generation.

### Repository

- `apps/macos/`: native app and Tail Hosting adapter.
- `scripts/flow-app.py`: build, installation, recovery, and migration.
- `tests/flow-app/`: app configuration and packaging recovery checks.
- `assets/branding/`: app icon and branding source.
- `docs/tinymist/`: canonical Typst documentation, generated web user guide, and reading demo.
- `openspec/`: app, engine, and preview behavior contracts.
- `crates/`: maintained tinymist engine and protocol implementations.
- `tools/typst-preview-frontend/` and `tools/typst-dom/`: preview frontend and document rendering.
- `editors/`: compatible editor integrations.

The earlier independent repository remains [tinymist-flow-archive](https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow-archive). README is generated from `docs/tinymist/tinymist-flow.typ`; the web and bundled PDF user guides share `docs/tinymist/flow-app.typ`. Regenerate Markdown with `node scripts/link-docs.mjs` using an external `typlite` executable.
